sloka: स्रस्तगात्रस्तु भरत: स वाचा सज्जमानया ।कृताञ्जलिरिदं वाक्यं राघवं पुनरब्रवीत् ॥ २.११२.९॥
transliteration: srastagātrastu bharata: sa vācā sajjamānayā ।kṛtāñjaliridaṁ vākyaṁ rāghavaṁ punarabravīt ॥ 2.112.9॥

translations.english: Before Bharata, with his limbs trembling and with palms folded (in reverence) was ready to depart, he said to Rama:
